also: which hand do you write with?

evidence: Suet. Tib. 68: sinistrā manū agiliōre ac validiōre, of Tiberius, who was left-handed
terms.comment: Morgan–Owens’s phrase, made on Suetonius’s description of Tiberius, whose left hand was the quicker and stronger. Among themselves Latin speakers simply ask which hand someone uses: see the examples.

terms.gloss: one who uses the right hand more strongly

phrases.english: Which hand do you write with? — My right.
his left hand was the quicker and the stronger

sources: Lewis & Short: dexter · Lewis & Short: agilis
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. hand: left-handed: right-handed.
